title: 第二十一章 姜辰的礼物第二十二章 蒋南孙心乱如麻
content_zh:
“姜辰，你终于来了。”
蒋家的门口，蒋鹏飞等候多时了。
“蒋叔。”
姜辰拿出了早已准备好的礼物，对蒋鹏飞说道：“今天我来打扰你了。”
“什么打扰不打扰的，来这里就当来自己家一样。”蒋鹏飞对旁边的蒋南孙说道：“南孙，你还不帮姜辰拿东西。”
“蒋叔，我自己可以。”姜辰连忙道。
走进蒋家，姜辰就看见了蒋南孙的奶奶和母亲。
“阿姨，你好，这是我给你准备的小礼物。”姜辰一边和蒋南孙的母亲戴茵打招呼，一边将手中的礼盒递给她。
“姜辰，你太客气了。”戴茵打量着姜辰。
之前蒋鹏飞在她的面前不止一次说起姜辰，甚至将姜辰夸的天上地下绝无仅有。对此，戴茵是将信将疑的，不过，现在看到姜辰，她觉得非常的满意。
至少比蒋鹏飞之前介绍的人强。
“奶奶，这是我给你的礼物。”姜辰也将一份礼物递给了蒋南孙的奶奶。
“好，好，好。”蒋奶奶满意的笑了笑。
“蒋叔，这是给你的。”姜辰将最后一份礼物递给了蒋鹏飞。
“姜辰，来坐。”
蒋鹏飞拉着姜辰在沙发上坐下。
“谢蒋叔。”
“姜辰啊，最近你有没有关注股市啊？”蒋鹏飞问道。
这段时间没有姜辰，蒋鹏飞不仅仅没有赚到钱，还亏了不少的钱。
这也是他逼迫蒋南孙将姜辰带到家里来的原因。

“蒋叔，最近我已经将股市中的钱全部抽出来了。”姜辰说道。
“啊，你不炒股了？”蒋鹏飞惊讶的问道。
“至少现在不炒了。这段时间我注册了一个公司，以后，我的全部精力都将放在公司上。”姜辰说道。
“那你对股市怎么看？”蒋鹏飞问道。
“最近形势不太好，我觉得蒋叔可以空仓休息一段时间。”姜辰的话也不是骗蒋鹏飞，最近一段时间，无论是他自己还是星辰投资，玩的不是国际期货就是美股等国外的股市，至于A股，现在风险有些大了，已经很长时间已经碰了。
“空仓休息？”蒋鹏飞摇摇头。
他怎么可能空仓休息呢？
炒股就是他的生命，他恨不得一天二十四小时投入到股票中，恨不得账户上的每一分钱都买入股票。
“蒋叔，这是我的判断，我觉得你有必要休息一段时间。”姜辰点点头，不过他也知道这是不可能的，蒋鹏飞如果有这个自制力，他在剧中就不会去借钱炒股啦。
“我还是再看看吧。”蒋鹏飞心中纠结。
如果不是知道姜辰的能力，他会对姜辰的话充耳不闻，但就是知道姜辰的能力，他才如此的纠结。
姜辰没有多说，来到了蒋南孙身边。
“你过来干什么？”蒋南孙横了姜辰一眼。
“今天我是以你男朋友的身份来的，要是不过来，不是让蒋叔他们怀疑吗？”姜辰低声说道。
“……”蒋南孙。
content_en:
"Jiang Chen, you are finally here."
At the door of Jiang's house, Jiang Pengfei had been waiting for a long time.
"Uncle Jiang."
Jiang Chen took out the gift he had prepared and said to Jiang Pengfei, "I'm here to disturb you today."
"No need to disturb me, just treat yourself as if you were at your own home." Jiang Pengfei said to Jiang Nansun next to him: "Nansun, why don't you help Jiang Chen get his things."
"Uncle Jiang, I can do it myself." Jiang Chen said quickly.
When Jiang Chen walked into Jiang's house, he saw Jiang Nansun's grandmother and mother.
"Hello, aunt, this is a small gift I prepared for you." Jiang Chen greeted Jiang Nansun's mother, Dai Yin, and handed her the gift box in his hand.
"Jiang Chen, you are too polite." Dai Yin looked at Jiang Chen.
Jiang Pengfei had talked about Jiang Chen in front of her more than once before, and even praised Jiang Chen as the only one in the world. Dai Yin was doubtful about this, but now that she saw Jiang Chen, she felt very satisfied.
At least better than the people Jiang Pengfei introduced before.
"Grandma, this is my gift to you." Jiang Chen also handed a gift to Jiang Nansun's grandma.
"Okay, okay, okay." Grandma Jiang smiled with satisfaction.
"Uncle Jiang, this is for you." Jiang Chen handed the last gift to Jiang Pengfei.
"Jiang Chen, come and sit."
Jiang Pengfei pulled Jiang Chen and sat down on the sofa.
"Thank you, Uncle Jiang."
"Jiang Chen, have you paid attention to the stock market recently?" Jiang Pengfei asked.
Without Jiang Chen during this period, Jiang Pengfei not only failed to make any money, but also lost a lot of money.
This was also the reason why he forced Jiang Nansun to bring Jiang Chen home.
"Uncle Jiang, I have withdrawn all the money from the stock market recently." Jiang Chen said.
"Ah, you don't trade stocks anymore?" Jiang Pengfei asked in surprise.
"At least I won't speculate now. During this period, I registered a company. From now on, all my energy will be focused on the company." Jiang Chen said.
"Then what do you think of the stock market?" Jiang Pengfei asked.
"The situation is not very good recently. I think Uncle Jiang can take a short rest for a while." Jiang Chen's words are not to lie to Jiang Pengfei. In recent times, both he and Xingchen Investment have been playing either international futures or foreign stock markets such as US stocks. As for A-shares, the risks are a bit high now, and they have been involved for a long time.
"Rest in a short position?" Jiang Pengfei shook his head.
How could he rest on a short position?
Stock trading is his life. He can't wait to invest in stocks 24 hours a day, and he can't wait to buy stocks with every penny in his account.
"Uncle Jiang, this is my judgment. I think you need to rest for a while." Jiang Chen nodded, but he also knew that this was impossible. If Jiang Pengfei had this self-control, he would not borrow money to trade stocks in the play.
"I'd better take another look." Jiang Pengfei was confused.
If he hadn't known Jiang Chen's ability, he would have turned a deaf ear to Jiang Chen's words, but knowing Jiang Chen's ability made him so entangled.
Jiang Chen didn't say much and came to Jiang Nansun's side.
"What are you doing here?" Jiang Nansun glanced at Jiang Chen.
"I'm here today as your boyfriend. If I don't come over, wouldn't it make Uncle Jiang and the others suspicious?" Jiang Chen said in a low voice.
"..." Jiang Nansun.
